title: 🔴 Why pilots LOVE this plane! ✈️ Pilatus PC-12 Rocky Mountain Flight (Friday flight)
description:
The Pilatus PC-12 is known as the "Swiss Army Knife" of the skies for a reason! 🇨🇭 Today, we’re tackling a stunning 302 nm hop from Bozeman to Salt Lake City, crossing the rugged terrain of the Rockies. 🏔️

🎙️ JOIN THE CREW: Want to chat while we fly? Our Discord voice channel opens at 19:00 UTC. Hop in here: https://discord.gg/J3tZyhceUM 🔗

This is a special Friday Flight edition! 🗓️ Join us as we manage the high-altitude performance of this single-engine turboprop and navigate a challenging descent into KSLC. 📉 If you've ever wondered why this is one of the most popular planes in general aviation, this flight will show you! 💎

Flight Log:

🛫 Departure: Bozeman Yellowstone (KBZN)
🛬 Destination: Salt Lake City (KSLC)
✈️ Aircraft: Pilatus PC-12
📏 Distance: 302 nm
⏱️ Est. Time: 1h 05m

Would you fly this solo? Let me know in the comments! 👇
